new: Studio cards have Streams: an object's, shape's, empty's, sound's or cube's position, turn (yaw, pitch, roll), speed, velocity per axis, acceleration, turning speed, size, shown, clip, path or motion phase, the nearest person's distance, or how many people stand in a cube, sent by the output page as a MIDI controller (also 14-bit), a note when it crosses a level (louder when it moves faster) or OSC.
Trails: an item can leave a glowing trail, and the scene's Hand trails draw people's hands; everyone at the circle sees them.

Loops on the beat: Record on the beat records an item's movement for 1, 2, 4 or 8 bars from the next downbeat and loops it locked to the room's beat; a sequence can be locked to the beat too, and Record events records presses, cube and pointing sends, show and hide into it, quantised.

The room's beat has bars. The output page takes MIDI clock with Start and Song Position, can lead with its own Tempo (Tap, Start, Stop), and sends MIDI clock out so a DAW or Cardinal follows the room.
A new room format (networks-52): every device needs this release.
test: Output page: Tempo 120, Start, MIDI clock out to a loopMIDI port; your DAW or Cardinal should follow and start on the bar.
The other way: your DAW sends clock into the output page with MIDI clock to the room's beat on; a motion On the beat follows.
Add a stream on a shape's card (Speed to CC 21), carry it in a headset and watch the value on the output page; try a threshold note.
Record on the beat (2 bars) while carrying something; it should loop exactly on the bar and stretch when the tempo changes.
Record events on a sequence while pressing items; turn Hand trails on and wave at someone at the same circle.
untested: Real MIDI ports, DAWs and Cardinal, clock jitter over Wi-Fi.
